prompt:

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Title: Public health project
Hi, For now I’m a public health student, and I need an expert for my project which is working with SAS program and put the database from NHANES. I need tables and charts regarding to that My project is about correlation of being a single mother pregnant and having more Caries in compare to other pregnant women.
</job>

(none)

text:
You need help using SAS to work with NHANES data and create the tables and charts for your public health project on whether single pregnant mothers have more caries than other pregnant women.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in machine learning and data analysis, and I can help structure the dataset, organize the variables, and prepare clear tables and charts for your analysis. I work with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and statistical data workflows, so I’m comfortable handling data cleaning, comparison groups, and presenting results in a way that supports your research question.

If you’d like, I can help you turn the NHANES database into a clean analysis-ready format and produce the visuals you need for your report.
